neighbours.label: Best guess: the punctuation or space right before or inside a number in a source citation, a date or a percentage ('Laws of Gifts to the Poor 10:', 'on October ', 'almost '); the same text with the number in words, or with none, stays quiet.

“Honor the old” (Sefer HaChinuch, Laws of Commandments 257:1).

short: slot before a number in a citation or date (guess)
notes: Probes were almost all under 0.1. One sentence read 0.76 on ':' ('Laws of Gifts to the Poor 10:1'), one 0.24 on ' ' before a date, but citations such as 'Genesis 1:1', 'Psalm 23:1' and 'Laws of Kings 11:4' read 0.03-0.04, and a long date 0.02-0.13. The card's '30%' and hex '0' are not covered by a firm reading either. Fire sentences use different sources so that the one 0.76 frame does not carry the test; near misses keep the citation. I have no firm reading of this pole; expected to fail.
